info.title: Queue OpenAPI for alibaba/qwen-image-3/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the alibaba/qwen-image-3/edit queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit images using Qwen Image 3 Pro.

QwenImage3EditInput.title: QwenImage3EditInput

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Enable automatic LLM prompt rewriting for better results.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

examples: Change the wolves into extremely realistic small puppies of different colors.
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired edit. Supports Chinese and English. Max 5000 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable content moderation for input and output. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

image_urls.description: Reference images for editing (1-3 images required). Order matters: reference as 'image 1', 'image 2', 'image 3' in prompt. Resolution: 384-2048px each dimension. Max size: 10MB each. Formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG (no alpha), WEBP.
image_urls.title: Image Urls

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. If not provided, the model determines the resolution automatically. Total number of pixels must be between 512x512 and 2048x2048.
image_size.title: Image Size

examples: low resolution, error, worst quality, low quality, deformed
negative_prompt.description: Content to avoid in the generated image. Max 500 characters.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.
num_images.title: Num Images

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

QwenImage3EditInput.description: Input for Qwen Image 3 image editing with reference images.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
